enriched.title: Passado Simples, Contínuo e Vocabulário Telefônico
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Past Simple e Past Continuous, com foco em diferenças e aplicações práticas, além de introduzir vocabulário relacionado a telefonemas e expressões úteis no idioma inglês.
mainTopics: Construção de frases com linguagem de negócios

vocabulary.definition: To end a phone call by hanging up the receiver or pressing the end button.
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.

vocabulary.definition: To attach or suspend something so that it is supported only from above.
examples: He hung his jacket on the hook.

vocabulary.definition: To direct your eyes to something or someone.
examples: She looked at the painting for hours.

vocabulary.definition: To try to find something or someone.
examples: The agent was looking for their account details.

vocabulary.definition: To make someone believe something that is not true.
examples: He tried to deceive his parents about his grades.
I love the lyrics of this song.

vocabulary.definition: A strong, regular repeated pattern of movement or sound.
examples: The song has a great rhythm.

vocabulary.definition: To be confined in a prison.
examples: He spent two years in jail.
He is known for his generosity.

vocabulary.definition: To fall or let something fall.
A person whose job is to serve or assist customers.
examples: The attendant helped me find my seat.

grammar.explanation: The Past Simple is used for completed actions in the past, while the Past Continuous is used for ongoing actions that were happening at a specific moment in the past.
rules: Use the Past Simple for actions that are finished: Subject + verb (past form).
Use the Past Continuous for actions in progress in the past: Subject + was/were + verb(-ing).
When a shorter action (Past Simple) interrupts a longer action (Past Continuous), use 'while' or 'when'.
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.
The sales team was celebrating their success when the manager announced more work.
While the analysts were studying the market trends, the stock price dropped suddenly.
commonMistakes: Using Past Simple for actions in progress (e.g., 'I watched TV when she called.' Instead, use 'I was watching TV when she called.')
Using Past Continuous for completed actions (e.g., 'He was ate dinner.' Instead, use 'He ate dinner.')

expressions.usage: Usado quando alguém termina uma ligação telefônica.
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.

expressions.usage: Usado para descrever a ação de observar algo.
examples: She looked at the painting for hours.

expressions.usage: Usado para descrever a ação de buscar algo que não está visível.
examples: The agent was looking for their account details.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: The customer ______ while the agent was looking for their account details.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The action 'hung up' happened as a short, completed action during the longer ongoing action of 'looking for their account details'.

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct verb form: While the analysts ______ the market trends, the stock price ______ suddenly.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The continuous action 'were studying' sets the background for the short, completed action 'dropped'.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking countries, it's common to say 'hang up' when ending a phone call, even though most phones no longer physically hang on a hook.
Using polite language when talking to customers, such as 'please hold while I look for your details,' is considered professional in customer service.
studyTips: Practice contrasting Past Simple and Past Continuous by describing your daily activities and interruptions.
Listen to English songs and read the lyrics to improve vocabulary and pronunciation.
Use flashcards to memorize irregular verbs and their past forms.
originalExamples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details. (O cliente desligou enquanto o atendente procurava pelos detalhes da conta deles.)
The sales team was celebrating their success when the manager announced more work. (A equipe de vendas estava comemorando seu sucesso quando o gerente anunciou mais trabalho.)
While the analysts were studying the market trends, the stock price dropped suddenly. (Enquanto os analistas estudavam as tendências do mercado, o preço das ações caiu de repente.)
My mother was brought up by her cousins. (Minha mãe foi criada por seus primos.)
